$schema_note: Live counts that hs_game_sdk.relic_pick_model is checked against (tests/test_relic_pick_model.py, MeasuredTests); the mechanism is docs/models/relic-pick-spec.md. Each relic was placed by a direct DropRelic call with the chance roll skipped, and the relic the game built was counted from CreateItemNew's research log (class 16, by id b). Character: Suh, equipped 68@10, 140@10, 109@2, 15@10, 29@10, relic tab maxed 92@10 and 128@10.

measurements.what: Filter off: 150 relics built, 8 of them one of the six maxed relics (15, 29, 68, 140 once each, 92 three times, 128 once), and none a quest relic (141..155).
measurements.model: Uniform pick over the 141 non-quest relics plus the equipped copy of 109: a maxed relic comes out at (1 - copy/5) x 6/141, between 0.034 and 0.043 for any copy chance, and a quest relic never does.

measurements.what: Filter on (GetRelicQuest answering true for the six maxed relics): 150 relics built, none of them maxed and none a quest relic; the filter logged 10 skips.
measurements.model: With the six maxed ids added to the quest answer, the pick cannot yield them; the equipped copy never copies a relic at 10.

measurements.what: Filter on with every droppable id but 7 and 109 treated as maxed (research `relicfilter testmaxed 0-140 except 7,109`): 20 relics built, relic 7 ten times and 109 ten times.
measurements.model: The pick can only yield 7 or 109, equally, and the equipped copy adds only 109.
